title: Stop-map-rotation
description:
A very simple, yet useful plugin for making players unable to rotate item frames, to bypass the plugin, give yourself or the selected player, the "dev" tag.
Best use case would be for public multiplayer servers.
body:
![plugin logo](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/182174875/442346233-e110d58b-5c4d-4714-8779-d27d422c3d6f.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3NDY4MzYwMTgsIm5iZiI6MTc0NjgzNTcxOCwicGF0aCI6Ii8xODIxNzQ4NzUvNDQyMzQ2MjMzLWUxMTBkNThiLTVjNGQtNDcxNC04Nzc5LWQyN2Q0MjJjM2Q2Zi5wbmc_.x_EX1bBNMdgoak3PgNtRlc9LtX0XUdDXHjMXMGxjFp0)

Those Pesky Players! Rotating your amazing map art even in adventure mode! Let's disable it! To bypass the plugin, give yourself or the selected player, the "dev" tag
The best usecase for this plugin would be on multiplayer servers, where you are not in the mood to configure worldguard.
